nodes.label: Sequence & Number
nodes.description: Discrete mathematics and combinatorial number theory, including integer sequences, combinatorial structures, and the application of algebraic methods to counting and number-theoretic problems.

nodes.label: Agent & Learn
nodes.description: Reinforcement learning and multi-agent systems: autonomous agents learning from environment interaction, policy optimization, and cooperative/competitive multi-agent coordination.

nodes.label: Data & Model
nodes.description: A broad, high-volume ML and data methods cluster (79k+ papers) with generic vocabulary spanning machine learning, statistical modeling, computer vision, and data analysis. No single sub-field dominates. Likely a catch-all for papers that apply standard methods without specialized terminology.

nodes.label: Quantum & State
nodes.description: Quantum information and computing: entanglement theory, quantum protocols, quantum error correction, and the boundary between quantum mechanics and classical information processing.

nodes.label: Neutrino & Mass
nodes.description: Neutrino physics: oscillation measurements, mass hierarchy experiments, sterile neutrino searches, and detector-based observations from terrestrial and astrophysical sources.

nodes.label: Time & Method
nodes.description: A heterogeneous applied mathematics and physics cluster with no dominant sub-field (no category exceeds 6%). Vocabulary — time, method, distribution, process, model, particle, control — spans stochastic processes, statistical mechanics, fluid dynamics, and numerical methods. Precise identification uncertain.

nodes.label: Galaxy & Mass
nodes.description: Galaxy formation and large-scale structure: photometric and spectroscopic surveys, galaxy clustering statistics, mass functions, and the interplay between dark matter halos and baryonic matter.

nodes.label: Learn & Model
nodes.description: Deep learning foundations: supervised training methodology, neural architecture design, regularization techniques, and benchmark evaluation across vision, language, and tabular data tasks.

nodes.label: Spin & Magnetic
nodes.description: Spin physics and magnetic properties of quantum materials: spin–orbit coupling, exchange interactions, magnetic anisotropy, and strongly correlated electron behavior in mesoscopic systems.

nodes.label: Algorithm & Problem
nodes.description: Algorithm design and mathematical optimization: worst-case complexity analysis, combinatorial optimization, convex and non-convex solvers, and approximation algorithms.

nodes.label: Function & Space
nodes.description: Classical mathematical analysis: complex function theory, analytic number theory, harmonic analysis, and the study of special functions and their asymptotic behavior.

nodes.label: Space & Prove
nodes.description: Pure mathematics spanning algebraic geometry, arithmetic geometry, and combinatorics: schemes, varieties, Diophantine equations, and combinatorial identities approached through algebraic tools.

nodes.label: Black hole & Black
nodes.description: Black hole physics: thermodynamics, information paradox, quasi-normal modes, Hawking radiation, and black hole solutions in general relativity and string-theoretic contexts.

nodes.label: Method & Feature
nodes.description: Computer vision: object detection, semantic and instance segmentation, image classification, and feature learning — the primary cluster for visual recognition research.

nodes.label: User & Design
nodes.description: Software engineering, human–computer interaction, and system security: software design patterns, usability evaluation, distributed systems, and vulnerability analysis.

nodes.label: Emission & Line
nodes.description: Observational stellar and galactic astrophysics: spectral line analysis, circumstellar disk structure, interstellar medium emission, and dust properties in nearby and high-redshift environments.

nodes.label: Manifold & Curvature
nodes.description: Differential geometry and geometric topology: Riemannian manifolds, curvature flows, symplectic geometry, and geometric structures on compact spaces.

nodes.label: Model & Data
nodes.description: A large general-purpose ML and statistical modeling cluster (80k+ papers) covering probabilistic models, time-series, simulation, and prediction tasks. The mix of cs.LG, stat.ME, and cs.CL without any dominant category or distinctive vocabulary suggests this is a broad methods cluster rather than a coherent research community.

nodes.label: Phase & Transition
nodes.description: Phase transitions and critical phenomena in condensed matter: order parameters, symmetry breaking, renormalization group methods, and emergent phases in strongly correlated electron systems.

nodes.label: Attack & Adversarial
nodes.description: Adversarial machine learning and cybersecurity: adversarial attacks on classifiers, defense mechanisms, robustness certification, and the intersection of deep learning with security-critical applications.

nodes.label: Solution & Problem
nodes.description: Partial differential equations: existence, uniqueness, and regularity theory for boundary value problems, elliptic and parabolic equations, and numerical discretization methods.

nodes.label: Robot & Human
nodes.description: Robotics and human–robot interaction: manipulation planning, autonomous navigation, task and motion planning, and the design of systems that collaborate with or assist humans.

nodes.label: Network & Neural
nodes.description: Graph neural networks and complex network science: message-passing architectures, node and graph classification, and the analysis of social, biological, and infrastructure networks.

nodes.label: Graph & Vertex
nodes.description: Graph theory and combinatorial algorithms: vertex/edge properties, graph coloring, extremal combinatorics, and the design of efficient graph algorithms.

nodes.label: Polynomial & Degree
nodes.description: Algebraic and analytic combinatorics: polynomial methods, generating functions, enumerative identities, and number-theoretic properties of combinatorial sequences.

nodes.label: Theory & Field
nodes.description: Quantum field theory and theoretical gravity: gauge theories, string and M-theory, holography (AdS/CFT), supersymmetry, and approaches to quantum gravity.

nodes.label: Ray & Gamma ray
nodes.description: High-energy astrophysics: gamma-ray bursts, cosmic ray acceleration, active galactic nuclei jets, and multi-messenger observations combining photons, neutrinos, and gravitational waves.

nodes.label: Mode & Optical
nodes.description: Quantum optics and photonics: cavity quantum electrodynamics, laser physics, optical mode engineering, nonlinear optics, and photonic devices including single-photon sources.

nodes.label: Llm & Language
nodes.description: Large language models and generative AI: prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning, instruction tuning, LLM evaluation, and applications in code generation and knowledge retrieval (2020+).

nodes.label: Quark & Decay
nodes.description: Particle physics phenomenology and collider experiments: quark and hadron interactions, decay branching ratios, cross-section measurements, and Standard Model tests at the LHC.

nodes.label: Matrix & Eigenvalue
nodes.description: Numerical linear algebra and random matrix theory: eigenvalue solvers, matrix factorizations, low-rank approximations, and spectral properties of random matrices.

nodes.label: Alpha & Beta
nodes.description: Stochastic analysis and fractional calculus: α-stable processes, fractional differential equations, Malliavin calculus, and regularity theory for stochastic PDEs. Note: heavy overlap of Greek notation from physics papers makes precise identification uncertain.

nodes.label: Wave & Gravitational
nodes.description: Wave phenomena and gravitational physics: gravitational wave detection and numerical relativity (gr-qc, 10%), mathematical wave equations (math.AP, 9%), and optical wave propagation (physics.optics, 6%). The cluster spans classical and gravitational wave science — it is not exclusively LIGO-era gravitational wave astronomy.

nodes.label: Algebra & Lie
nodes.description: Abstract algebra: Lie algebras and Lie groups, module theory, representation theory, operator algebras, and categorical approaches to algebraic structures.

nodes.label: Video & Frame
nodes.description: Video understanding and temporal vision: action recognition, video object segmentation, optical flow, and temporal modeling for multi-frame visual tasks.

nodes.label: Star & Mass
nodes.description: Stellar astrophysics: stellar evolution, binary star systems, star cluster dynamics, stellar populations, and the observational characterization of stars across mass ranges.

nodes.label: Magnetic & Magnetic field
nodes.description: Magnetism and magnetic phenomena across scales: spin transport in quantum materials, magnetic phase transitions, and astrophysical magnetic field generation and evolution.

nodes.label: Log & Algorithm
nodes.description: Theoretical computer science: computational complexity, randomized and approximation algorithms, logarithmic-factor bounds, and connections to discrete probability.

nodes.label: Image & Method
nodes.description: Computational imaging and applied image processing: medical image segmentation, super-resolution, image reconstruction, and deep learning methods for low-level vision tasks.

nodes.label: Planet & Star
nodes.description: Exoplanet science and planetary astrophysics: transit photometry, radial velocity surveys, orbital dynamics, atmospheric characterization, and the architecture of planetary systems.

nodes.label: Energy & Temperature
nodes.description: Electronic structure and materials physics: band theory, surface and interface states, electron transport, and the computational and experimental study of functional materials.

nodes.label: Dark & Dark matter
nodes.description: Dark matter and dark energy: direct and indirect detection experiments, cosmological constraints, candidate particle models (WIMPs, axions), and modified gravity theories.

nodes.label: Channel & Communication
nodes.description: Information theory and communications engineering: channel capacity, error-correcting codes, wireless channel modeling, signal processing, and quantum communication protocols.

nodes.label: Language & Model
nodes.description: Pre-trained language models and NLP transfer learning: BERT-style pre-training, fine-tuning on downstream tasks, multi-task learning, and sequence-to-sequence architectures. Closely related to C28 (LLM cluster); C43 centers on the fine-tuning paradigm and task performance benchmarks rather than the emergent capabilities of very large models.

nodes.label: Lambda & Omega
nodes.description: Theoretical physics at the intersection of cosmology and mathematical physics, using Greek-letter parametrized models (Λ-CDM cosmological constant, density parameters) alongside rigorous analytical methods. Heterogeneous cluster; precise sub-field identification uncertain.

nodes.label: Speech & Model
nodes.description: Speech recognition and spoken language processing: acoustic modeling, end-to-end systems (CTC, attention-based), speaker verification, and the integration of language models with speech.

nodes.label: Group & Finite
nodes.description: Finite group theory and algebraic representation theory: group classification, character theory, modular representations, and Lie-theoretic approaches to algebraic structures.

nodes.label: Operator & Space
nodes.description: Functional analysis and operator theory: spectral theory of differential operators, Banach and Hilbert space methods, semigroup theory, and mathematical foundations of quantum mechanics.

nodes.label: Flow & Fluid
nodes.description: Fluid dynamics and soft matter: turbulence modeling, multiphase flows, viscoelastic fluids, granular systems, and numerical methods for the Navier–Stokes equations.

nodes.label: Gamma & Decay
nodes.description: Hadronic physics and particle decay processes: meson and baryon spectroscopy, photon–hadron interactions, branching fractions, and Feynman diagram calculations in quantum chromodynamics. Greek notation (γ, δ, Σ, Ω) dominates vocabulary; some mathematical physics papers co-cluster.
